#Module htmlmedia

HTMLMediaElement (<video>, <audio>): the media element state machine of HTML §4.8.11 (src/page/media_element.odin) on the media package's player. The events (loadstart ... ended) are plain events fired at the element; TimeRanges, MediaError and VideoPlaybackQuality are made by the engine (native/js/runtime/web_mediaobjects.c) from the numbers below.

Exposed to: Window. Source: api/media_element.widl.

Odin: import "wren:htmlmedia".

#Types

#handle HTMLMediaElement : Element

A <video> or <audio> element; anything else is not a live HTMLMediaElement.

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_HTMLMediaElement).

#callback VideoFrameRequestCallback

void VideoFrameRequestCallback(i32 user, f64 now)

requestVideoFrameCallback's callback: now is the current time on the page's performance timeline (the callback reads the rest of the metadata back with HTMLVideoElement_videoFrameMetadata, keyed by the id this call made).

#HTMLVideoElement_requestVideoFrameCallback

u64 HTMLVideoElement_requestVideoFrameCallback(HTMLMediaElement element, VideoFrameRequestCallback callback, i32 user = 0)

video.requestVideoFrameCallback(callback): the callback runs once, when a new video frame is presented (the same moment the playback-quality counters advance). Returns an id for cancelVideoFrameCallback (0: too many waiting, media.max_video_frame_callbacks).

Host: HTMLVideoElement_requestVideoFrameCallback :: proc(c: ^Call, element: Api_HTMLMediaElement, callback: u32, user: i32) -> u64

#HTMLVideoElement_videoFrameMetadata

bytes HTMLVideoElement_videoFrameMetadata(HTMLMediaElement element, u64 id)

The VideoFrameCallbackMetadata of the frame that fired callback id, snapshotted at presentation: eight f64 (presentationTime, expectedDisplayTime, width, height, mediaTime, presentedFrames, processingDuration, and a bitmask of which of the optional fields are present; here always 0 — captureTime/receiveTime/rtpTimestamp absent). Empty when the id is unknown.

Host: HTMLVideoElement_videoFrameMetadata :: proc(c: ^Call, element: Api_HTMLMediaElement, id: u64) -> []u8

#HTMLMediaElement_audioTracks

u64 HTMLMediaElement_audioTracks(HTMLMediaElement element)

element.audioTracks / videoTracks / textTracks: the handle of the list object (an AudioTrackList / VideoTrackList / TextTrackList of the mediatracks module; the engine wraps it). 0 when media.tracks.enabled is off. The same object each time (SameObject).

Host: HTMLMediaElement_audioTracks :: proc(c: ^Call, element: Api_HTMLMediaElement) -> u64
